Definition: Ajin, the name (thus simply) of two places in Palestine
BiblicalUsage: Ain = "spring"; 1) one of the landmarks on the eastern boundary of Palestine; 2) one of the southernmost cities of Judah in the Nekeb and allotted to the tribe of Simeon and given to the priests
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
